purpose: Commit a bounded metadata-level claim-to-source mapping after completion of all six human rights decisions. A mapping records which reviewed source and locator may support a claim for later review; it is not citation validation, technical review, instructional review, approval, or assessment eligibility.
invariants: A mapped claim may reference only a source present in the discovery manifest with a completed non-pending rights decision.
Mapped locators must be copied from the discovery manifest; this artifact does not invent new locators or excerpts.
Mapping does not imply technical correctness, applicability, citation validity, instructional suitability, approval, or assessment eligibility.
Claims with explicit unresolved source gaps, unverified thresholds, or unsupported causal relationships remain unmapped.
No verbatim source excerpt, question payload, scoring rule, or proprietary text is stored in this artifact.

mappings.claim_text: 13.5 V at battery under idle confirms alternator output is within spec
mappings.technical_caveat: Fixed 13.5 to 14.5 volt ranges are not universal; manufacturer specification governs and no single threshold may be taught as universal. The Coalinga source supports only a general healthy-system range; it does not establish that 13.5 V at idle, without specified load, temperature, battery state of charge, manufacturer specification or test procedure, conclusively confirms alternator output is within specification. This claim stays unmapped pending a vehicle/service-procedure-level or otherwise authoritative source.
mappings.mapping_notes: explicit source gap: 13.5 V at idle alone does not establish manufacturer-spec compliance without load, temperature, battery state, and procedure context
